First, note the date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 08-17-1018.  
Subtract 108 days:  

1018 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4 but before 1582 rules differ, but 1018 is not divisible by 4).  
Days in months before August 1018: July (31), June (30), May (31), April (30), March (31), February (28), January (31).  

From 08-17:  
Back 17 days → 08-01.  
Remaining 108 − 17 = 91 days to subtract before August.  

July 31 → back 31 days → 07-01, remaining 91 − 31 = 60 days.  
June 30 → back 30 days → 06-01, remaining 60 − 30 = 30 days.  
May 31 → back 31 days goes past May 1, so instead:  
From 06-01 back 30 days:  
May has 31 days, so 06-01 minus 30 days = 05-02 (since May 2 to May 31 is 30 days? Let’s check carefully).  

Better:  
We are at 08-01 after removing first 17 days.  
Subtract 91 days from 08-01:  
July: 31 days → 07-01 (91−31=60 left)  
June: 30 days → 06-01 (60−30=30 left)  
May: 31 days, but we only need 30 days back from 06-01:  
06-01 minus 30 days = 05-02.  

Thus final date: 1018-05-02.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1018-05-02
